interpretation: Exploratory follow-up on existing patient splits; previously inspected TEST is not a new independent confirmation.
encoder: Pinned original ImageNet ResNet18, frozen throughout. Reuse matching full-field features; do not use the v4 transferred encoder.
localizer_inputs: Frozen 512-dimensional slice features and two canonical geometric positions. No grades, AP fields or inference-time annotations.
level_targets: Normalize a Gaussian of physical plane distance with sigma 5mm over available same-series anchors; RSNA subarticular anchors are approximate disc-level references, not central canal grades.
localizer_prior: Fit median and MAD scale (clipped to 0.08..0.30) of target-weighted normalized frame position per level on TRAIN only. Gaussian log prior plus learned MLP residual, final layer initialized zero.
localizer_architecture: Linear(514,64),Tanh,Linear(64,2), plus fixed positional log prior; slice softmax separately per level.
localizer_selection: Mean hit within10mm across dataset/level validation groups; break ties by lower validation cross-entropy. Unchanged positional prior epoch0 is eligible. No TEST selection.
center_training: AISSLab TRAIN exact CCS center only. RSNA subarticular coordinates never supervise canal XY. Ignore grade/AP fields.
center_architecture: Frozen original 512x7x7 maps; Conv2d(512,32,3,padding1),ReLU,Conv2d(32,1,1),spatial softmax,soft-argmax normalized pixel centers.
center_selection: Lowest mean physical XY error on AISSLab validation, not grades. Train and validation patients remain disjoint.
localization_gate: Before severity fitting report validation localization against positional-only and uniform baselines. Require macro hit10 >=0.50 and AISSLab center median error <=10mm; if not reached, stop severity fitting and report failure rather than score TEST.
spinenet_geometry: Use cached sagittal numbering landmarks only with verified shared FrameOfReferenceUID; current RSNA has no confirmed shared-frame sagittal/axial series, so use axial localizer fallback. No blind cross-frame projection.
roi_preprocessing: Predicted level anchor and predicted canal center only. Reproject one predicted LPS center to same-series 2.5D neighbors, canonical physical50mm square, zero padding,224x224,original ImageNet normalization. Mean frozen512-vector over up to3 nearest centers within10mm.
severity_class_weights: Inverse square-root RSNA TRAIN class frequencies, normalized to mean one.
severity_selection: RSNA validation macro-F1 only; no AISSLab grade labels or TEST enters fit/selection. Seal all3 selected checkpoints before TEST.
evaluation: Report localization, center error (AISSLab exact only), prediction coverage and failures, severity per level/domain, severe misses and paired patient bootstrap. Missing references never become normal; all predictions retained. Compare original axial and strongest sagittal baselines on equal targets with coverage stated.
